note: Mixed bedrock-runtime 400 ValidationException set. Rows without an api key are InvokeModel captures (2026-07-28, global anthropic claude opus), byte-exact from the wire: the flat minimal {"message":...} shape with NO __type key. Rows with api converse use the same flat body around a Converse message: converse-field-probe carries a message captured verbatim on Converse (us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5); converse-advisor-composed (model composed) joins that captured Converse wrapper to the captured InvokeModel advisor message. converse-web-search-composed (model composed) joins the same captured Converse wrapper to the captured InvokeModel web_search template message. Rows with api invoke or converse and a named model (web-search-template-sonnet-5, structured-output-*, schema-error-*) carry messages captured verbatim on 2026-10-02 on that carrier and model; that includes the middle-anchored tool-type rejections (web-search-pydantic-*, computer-aws-*) and their must-not-learn neighbours (tool-removal-messages-*, tool-changes-*, toolset-name-*), which are read by dedicated extractors rather than the templates rows. Each templates row names the step that turns its token into a key: tool_type (open; the type minus any date suffix) or translated (closed; the translations rows). Near-misses output_config_effort, pydantic_* and aws_* are synthesized and were never captured. The exception discriminator rides in the x-amzn-ErrorType response header (recorded as error_type_header) and is lifted onto Error::Upstream.upstream_type as the bare, namespace-stripped name (lifted_type). replay_rows drive canaries (or near_miss_messages, by name) through real dispatch on a two-Bedrock-lane chain: request names the request shape, lane_a / lane_b name what each Bedrock lane answers ("accept" succeeds), expect_capability null means nothing may be learned, expect_served is the seat that serves. Kept as a data file, never inline .rs literals.
